info.title: Sahkar Saathi API
info.description: Multilingual cooperative governance and legal-information assistant (SIH 2026, problem statement 26088). Every error uses the shape `{"code": "...", "message": "..."}`. Language codes are short ISO codes (en, hi and the regional language). Public endpoints are rate-limited.

get.description: Warm this up before a demo. ``degraded`` means a dependency is down.

post.description:
Answer a question from cited public documents, ask for a state, or decline.

Pass the returned ``conversation_id`` back with follow-up questions. The returned
``message_id`` is what ``POST /feedback`` rates.
Transcribe a spoken question. The client shows the text for the user to confirm.

audio.description: Recorded question, e.g. audio/webm from MediaRecorder.
audio.title: Audio

language_hint.description: en, hi or the regional language.
language_hint.title: Language Hint

200.description: 16 kHz mono WAV audio of the text.

post.description: Read an answer aloud. Returns WAV audio for the Listen button.

post.summary: Rate an answer or send a comment
post.description: Thumbs up/down on an answer (with an optional reason), or a general comment.

get.description: Categories the user can pick before asking for guidance.

post.description:
Category, forum, steps, a documents checklist and an editable draft.

Nothing is submitted to any office. The draft contains [placeholders] for the
member's own details, which the client never sends back.

get.description: Structured scheme cards with source and date, for the Schemes page.
One scheme with its guide facts. ``pmfby`` powers the Crop insurance guide.

Short lessons and the optional three-question quiz. Falls back to English when the
requested language has no translation yet; ``language`` in the response says which.
The public documents the assistant searches, for the Law library page.

Hit rate, faithfulness, correct refusals, failed questions and recent runs.

Log in at /admin/ first; the browser then sends the session cookie. Returns sample
numbers (``is_sample: true``) until the eval runner saves real runs.
